Planning a dissertation in Art?

We have created a handpicked list of interesting dissertation titles for Indian art students, at undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral levels. The titles include emerging ideas and themes in Indian and global art regarding tradition and technology, identity politics, and social and political articulation. Irrespective of whether you chose to work in the territory of art history, contemporary art and digital media, or cultural studies, these titles provide an interesting starting point for your research. The Impact of Political Turbulence on Indian Contemporary Art: A Post-2014 Perspective The Space Between Canvas and Code: Digital Art Movements in India Challenges to Auditor Independence in Small and Medium Audit Firms in India The Right to Identity through Native Art Practices – Tribal India Body as Medium: Feminist Art History in Contemporary South Asia Public Art and Urban Transformation: A Case Study of Wall Murals in Mumbai and Delhi The Art of Memory and Visual Narratives in Post-Partition Art Art as Protesting: Representational Study of Visual Resistance in Indian Student Movements Reimagining Mythology: Traditional Motifs in Contemporary Indian Sculpture From Galleries to Instagram: The Transformation of Indian Art Consumption Spiritual Aesthetics in the Contemporary Works of Modern Indian Artists Intercultural Symbols in Indian Diaspora Artworks If any of these themes align with your interests, then you have a great starting point! When you are prepared to develop your idea, visit our “How to Write a Dissertation Title” article to guide you in narrowing down a focused and engaging research topic.
